integrity: Exact whole-support finite enumeration, two independent transition constructions and two terminal-SCC algorithms; structural construction proved analytically; no independent scientific audit performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite exhaustive classification only for connected simple graphs with 2 to 5 vertices; larger-graph result is a sufficient balanced-hub construction, not a classification; no entry probabilities asserted; undirected synchronous no-self-loop majority with independent positive-probability ties only.
title: Sharp five-vertex onset of stochastic recurrent majority dynamics
